description: This file defines a Blazor component class 'ToastComponent' used to display toast notifications in a web application. It manages visibility, appearance, and content of toast messages based on event handlers from the 'ToastService'.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component for displaying toast notifications with customizable styles and message content, reacting to events from ToastService.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the component and subscribes to toast show/hide events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles the display of a toast message with specified content and level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Sets up the visual styles and heading based on the toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from toast events when the component is disposed.
